1.en_consolidated_definition:
Chota (n.) 

A type of small, usually wild or feral pig found in Puerto Rico, often considered a pest due to its ability to cause significant damage to crops and vegetation.

Nota: En el contexto de la cultura puertorriqueña, "chota" se refiere comúnmente a este tipo de cerdo salvaje.
